clock_waveform.NV_DDR_clock_source: Host-generated CLK on WE_n pin; rising-edge latches cmd/addr.
clock_waveform.sdr_data_latching: Card / device outputs change on falling edge of RE_n; host samples on rising / falling per timing table; write byte latched on rising edge of WE_n.
clock_waveform.nv_ddr_data_latching: Both edges of DQS latch data; CLK rising edge latches command / address; tDQSCK / tDQSRE / tDQSD anchor read / write phases relative to CLK.
clock_waveform.nv_ddr2_3_data_latching: Both edges of DQS_t (cross with DQS_c) latch data; WE_n rising edge latches command / address; ODT, ZQ calibration, and DCC training stabilise the eye.

command_cycle_waveform_sdr.description: CE_n LOW, CLE HIGH, ALE LOW, WE_n LOW→HIGH; DQ latched as command opcode.

address_cycle_waveform_sdr.description: 1..5 address-cycle pulses: CE_n LOW, CLE LOW, ALE HIGH, WE_n LOW→HIGH; DQ latched as address byte.

write_data_cycle_waveform_sdr.description: CE_n LOW, CLE LOW, ALE LOW, WE_n LOW→HIGH; DQ latched as write byte.

read_data_cycle_waveform_sdr.description: CE_n LOW, CLE LOW, ALE LOW, RE_n HIGH→LOW; device drives next read byte on DQ; host samples after tREA.

cmd_addr_data_waveform_nv_ddr.description: Continuous CLK; cmd/addr latched on rising CLK; tCAD interval; W/R_n selects bus owner; bidirectional DQS.

cmd_addr_data_waveform_nv_ddr2_3.description: WE_n latches cmd/addr; DQS_t/DQS_c data; NV-DDR3 adds RE_t/RE_c.

ready_busy_waveform.signal: R/B_n open-drain output; pulled HIGH externally; LOW when any LUN busy.
ready_busy_waveform.after_program: R/B_n LOW from end of 10h cycle to end of tPROG.
ready_busy_waveform.after_erase: R/B_n LOW from end of D0h cycle to end of tBERS.
ready_busy_waveform.after_read: R/B_n LOW from end of 30h cycle to end of tR.
ready_busy_waveform.after_reset: R/B_n LOW from end of FFh cycle to end of tRST.

reset_waveform.step_3: After tRST (max 5 ms first reset; max 500 µs subsequent; max 5 µs Synchronous Reset), device drives R/B_n HIGH.
reset_waveform.step_4: FFh defaults to SDR mode 0; FCh preserves data interface.

page_program_waveform.step_3: Host writes page-size bytes of data (CLE=ALE=0); tADL window after second address byte.
page_program_waveform.step_5: After tWB, device drives R/B_n LOW for tPROG.
page_program_waveform.step_6: Host polls Read Status (70h) or waits for R/B_n HIGH; checks FAIL bit.

block_erase_waveform.step_4: After tWB, device drives R/B_n LOW for tBERS.
block_erase_waveform.step_5: Host polls Read Status; checks FAIL bit.

read_waveform.step_4: After tWB, device drives R/B_n LOW for tR.
read_waveform.step_5: Device drives R/B_n HIGH; host polls Read Status or Read Status Enhanced.
read_waveform.step_6: Host pulses RE_n (SDR) or RE_t/RE_c + DQS (NV-DDR family) to clock out page bytes.

zq_calibration_waveform.step_1: Host issues ZQ Calibration Long (F9h) or Short (D9h).
zq_calibration_waveform.step_2: Device drives R/B_n LOW for tZQCL (long, ≥ 1 µs) or tZQCS (short).
zq_calibration_waveform.step_3: Device updates output driver impedance against external RZQ.
zq_calibration_waveform.step_4: Device drives R/B_n HIGH; output drivers now use updated impedance for subsequent NV-DDR2/NV-DDR3 traffic; FAIL bit indicates calibration outcome.

general_timing_parameters_referenced: tWB — WE_n HIGH to R/B_n LOW
tWHR — WE_n HIGH to RE_n LOW (Read Status)
tZQCL / tZQCS — ZQ Calibration Long / Short
tDQSCK / tDQSRE / tDQSD / tDQSHZ / tDQSQ / tQH (NV-DDR family)
tWPRE / tWPST / tRPRE / tRPST — DQS write/read preamble/postamble
general_timing_rule: All command/address/data transfers reference host strobes (WE_n/CLK for cmd/addr; RE_n/DQS for data). Section 4.17 of ONFI 4.1 defines per-mode timing tables: SDR (4.18.1), NV-DDR (4.18.2), NV-DDR2/3 (4.18.3).
